comment: Level 0 (tutorial, no stars): a guided tour of the MPC loop, nothing for the player to change (no knobs). Small 20 m field and a moving start (start_velocity) so the plans and inputs are easy to see (an agreed exception to the 50 m field). Read by BOTH the game (controlquest/gameplay/level_data.py) and the engine (engine_server/level_rules/common.py). Calibrated with engine_server/calibrate.py.
